question: Should the experimental v1 Claw contract make a non-empty `CLAW.md` body the canonical managed `SOUL.md` source before the related RFC direction is accepted?
rationale: The implementation changes portable package semantics across installation, update, provenance, and export; its RFC-linked design cannot be settled by a mechanical patch review alone.

options.title: Confirm the body-as-prompt contract
options.body: Accept the RFC direction, then require the UTF-8 parser repair and real round-trip proof before merge.

options.title: Keep prompts as explicit sidecars
options.body: Retain the current explicit `SOUL.md` source contract and close or narrow this proposal until the RFC is accepted.

recommendation.title: Confirm the body-as-prompt contract
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC direction, then require the UTF-8 parser repair and real round-trip proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The author is the only concrete contact in the supplied evidence for the RFC-linked design and can route the proposal to the appropriate product owner.
